# Daily Murli Reader

> Daily Murli Reader helps Brahma Kumaris students read the daily Murli from anywhere, in 10 languages.

Daily Murli Reader is a student-made web reader. It is not the official Brahma Kumaris website.

Who it is for: Brahma Kumaris students.

## Product

- Read the daily Murli by date
- Choose among 10 Murli languages: Hindi, Gujarati, English, Nepali, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Bengali, and Oriya
- Listen to audio when it is available for the selected date and language
- Print the Murli
- Increase, decrease, or reset font size
- Switch between light and dark mode

## Pages

- [Home](https://murli.devagn.com/): read the daily Murli by date and language
